title: 第6章 抓到一个偷窥狂-《系统送编，从外卖员成007探员》
content:
第(1/3)页

    这时面板弹出了一条系统消息。

    [首次获得正义值，开启系统商城]

    系统面板上多了一个商城选项。

    顾承安想着点开，界面瞬间变换。

    就一个孤零零的搜索框悬在正中央。

    顾承安扯了扯嘴角。这系统真够省事的。

    想了想，他在搜索框里输入“黑客技能”。

    屏幕弹出一行字：【黑客技能：500正义值。】

    顾承安眼皮跳了一下。

    他删掉，重新输入“格斗术”。

    【综合格斗术：500正义值。】

    再换“微表情”。

    【微表情识别：300正义值。】

    顾承安盯着自己那可怜的10点余额，默默关掉了面板。

    抓个小偷才给10点。要换个最便宜的微表情识别，得连抓三十个小偷。

    他想了想，又打开搜索框，输入“透视眼”。

    【警告：本系统遵循基础物理法则，不可兑换超自然能力。】

    行吧。顾承安彻底死心。脚踏实地，从底层做起。

    还不知道工资情况呢，外卖还是要送的，得搞点收入。

    他戴上外卖头盔，拧动油门。电动车汇入车流中。

    基因药剂的改造效果正在显现。顾承安发现自己的视力变得极好，十几米外汽车车牌上的泥点都看得清清楚楚。反应速度也大幅提升，前面一辆网约车突然变道，他连刹车都没捏，腰部发力，车把一拐，贴着网约车的后视镜滑了过去。

    流畅，精准。

    接单，取餐，送餐。

    两单外卖送完。一单送到写字楼裙楼商场，一单送到旁边的单身公寓。

    送完第二单，顾承安把车停在写字楼裙楼商场外面的阴凉处。鹏城的夏天热得发闷，空气里全是柏油路面烤化了的味道。

    他摘下头盔，拿脖子上的毛巾擦了把汗。

    顾承安掏出手机，点开天珠APP。

    里面列表里密密麻麻全是采集到的数据

    白领、保洁、保安、店员、外卖同行等。

    顾承安的手指在屏幕上滑动，突然停住。

    一条数据夹在众多普通职业中间。

    【姓名：李建业】

    【身份证号：420122……15】

    【手机号：186*****332】
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

At this time, a system message popped up on the panel.

[Get the justice value for the first time and open the system mall]

There is an additional mall option on the system panel.

Gu Chengan thought about clicking it, and the interface changed instantly.

There is just a lone search box hanging in the center.

Gu Chengan twitched his lips.This system is so trouble-free.

After thinking for a while, he entered "hacking skills" in the search box.

A line of text popped up on the screen: [Hacker Skill: 500 Justice Value.】

Gu Chengan’s eyelids twitched.

He deleted it and re-entered "fighting skills".

【Mixed Martial Arts: 500 justice value.】

Then change the "micro-expression".

【Micro-expression recognition: 300 justice value.】

Gu Chengan stared at his pitiful 10-point balance and silently turned off the panel.

Only 10 points will be given if you catch a thief.To change to the cheapest micro-expression recognition, you have to catch thirty thieves in a row.

He thought for a while, then opened the search box and entered "clairvoyance eye".

【Warning: This system follows basic physical laws and cannot be exchanged for supernatural abilities.】

Gu Chengan gave up completely.Keep your feet on the ground and start from the bottom.

I don’t know the salary situation yet, but I still have to deliver food, so I need to make some income.

He put on his takeout helmet and turned the accelerator.Electric vehicles merge into traffic.

The transformation effects of genetic agents are emerging.Gu Chengan found that his eyesight had become so good that he could clearly see the mud spots on the license plates of cars more than ten meters away.His reaction speed also improved significantly. When an online ride-hailing car in front of him suddenly changed lanes, he didn't even apply the brakes. He exerted force on his waist, turned the handlebar, and slid past the online ride-hailing car's rearview mirror.

​ Smooth and precise.

​Taking orders, picking up meals, and delivering meals.

​ Two takeaway orders have been delivered.One order is delivered to the shopping mall on the podium of the office building, and the other is delivered to the single apartment next to it.

After delivering the second order, Gu Chengan parked his car in the shade outside the shopping mall on the podium of the office building.The summer in Pengcheng is swelteringly hot, and the air is full of the smell of roasted asphalt roads.

He took off his helmet and wiped the sweat with the towel around his neck.

Gu Chengan took out his mobile phone and clicked on the Tianzhu APP.

The list inside is densely packed with collected data.

​​White-collar workers, cleaning staff, security guards, store clerks, takeaway colleagues, etc.

Gu Chengan’s finger slid across the screen and suddenly stopped.

A piece of data is sandwiched among many ordinary professions.

【Name: Li Jianye】

【ID number: 420122……15】

【Mobile phone number: 186*****332】
